newsitem.title: FRANCE: France must continue to make combat planes-Chirac.
newsitem.headline: France must continue to make combat planes-Chirac.

text.p: French President Jacques Chirac said on Saturday France must maintain its capacity to produce combat aircraft.

He was speaking at the inauguration of the Paris air show where the number of front line combat aircraft and the number of countries which still have the capacity to produce them, has been steadily dropping for years.

"France, which is a great power, must maintain its capacity to produce combat aircraft," Chirac told reporters when visiting the exhibit area of France's Dassault Aviation, one of Europe's last surviving combat aircraft manufacturers.

Dassault hopes its Rafale fighter-bomber can challenge American industries in export sales in the same way as the European Airbus Industrie consortium has proved a major competitor for the U.S. giant Boeing in the passenger plane field.
